QuestInfo.name: Empress's Might
QuestInfo.0: Explorer Chiefs have joined with Empress Cygnus at Ereve to create the Ultimate Explorer! You should go see #b#p1090000##k.
QuestInfo.1: Get the moonlight-filled dew for Shinsoo from #rBrown Hares#k.
QuestInfo.2: With reinforcement from the Empress, you can now equip items 10 Levels higher.

0.0: You must have heard the rumor already. The chiefs have united with Empress Cygnus of Ereve to create the ultimate explorer.
0.1: It's true that we've united, but most of their power comes from the teachings of the Empress. Would you like to receive the teachings of the Empress as well?

yes.0: As expected, you wish to become stronger. But the Empress won't open her heart to a stranger. I suggest you take #b20#k drops of #b#t4032862##k to Shinsoo, whom the Empress trusts most.
yes.1: You can obtain #b#t4032862##k from #rDesert Rabbits#k in Ariant.

no.0: Receiving the teachings of the Empress will make you even stronger.

1.0: What are you doing here?\r\n#L0##bI've brought Lunar Dew for Shinsoo.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, these are precious... To show you my gratitude, I will make you stronger, adventurer.

yes.0: With the power I have granted you, you can now equip gear that is 10 levels higher than your character level. However, you still seem to have a long way to go until you can fight the Black Mage.
yes.1: It might be a good idea to talk to #bChief Knight Hawkeye#k before you leave Ereve.

npc.0: Find #b20 drops of Lunar Dew#k for Shinsoo on #rDesert Rabbits#k in Ariant before you head to Ereve to see the Empress. You can reach Ereve by taking the airship from the Air Field in Six Path Crossway.

item.0: I do not wish to talk to strangers.
